archetypes.name: dyn-baseline-integrity
archetypes.rationale: Guarded baseline writes and read-back validation need path and publication scrutiny.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the lint baseline read and write pipeline for path containment, symlink handling, and failures after publication. Verify malformed or stale baseline data cannot hide new findings or produce partial output. Check that read-back validation proves the published bytes and records match the intended baseline. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
